🎈7월에만 비비밀 6시에 시작!!😍

     ✅️ 블루스 강습은 5:30분!

"이상한 나라의 앨리스가 된 것 같아요 
이런 특이한 옴니버스 파티는 상상도 못했는데 
음악이 너무 좋으니 신나서 끝까지 췄어요😍"

"다양한 놀이기구를 타는 것 같아 완전 신나요 ㅎㅎ"

"규칙이 없다보니 하고 음악에 맞춰 표현하고 싶은거 내 마음대로 다 할수 있어서 완전 꿀잼~뮤지컬리티가 팍팍 늘어요😆"

"블루스 강습 넘 재밌었구 거기서 배운걸 탱고에서 알차게 써먹고 있어요 넘 감사해요!"

지인분들과 함께 오셔서 자유롭게 하고 싶은 거 다하시고 또 파티에 오신 다른 분들과도(한곡씩만 추면 되니까)
 싹~다 춰보세요!😉👍

여성분들은 신발 편하게 연습화나 7cm 이하로 신으시면 더 풀딴추기 좋겠죠?😆🎶

맛있는 무알콜 칵테일 준비할께요

저번달에는 칵테일통 사라지고 음료수 도둑 맞아서 참외가 도착하기전까지 음료가 허접해서 죄송ㅠ

참고로 비비밀은 주류 제공,판매안하니 본인이 알아서 가져오시고(콜지키 프리) 와인은 피스타 냉장고에서 무인으로 계산하시고 꺼내드시면 됩니다^^

19일에도 신나게 달려봐용!🥰

신청,확인 ➡️ vivimil.com

🎈 Only in July, Vivimil begins at 6:00 PM!! 😍  
🕕  6:00–10:00 PM @ Pista 
✅️ Free Blues Lesson at 5:30 PM!

" I felt like Alice in Wonderland
 I never imagined a party this unique and unpredictable.  
The music was so amazing that I couldn't stop dancing until the very end!" 😍

 "It's like riding a whole bunch of different amusement park rides—so much fun! 😂"

 "There are no rules, so I can express whatever I feel through the music and dance however I want. It's an absolute blast, and my musicality has improved so much!" 😆

 "The Blues lesson was so much fun! I've been using what I learned there in my Tango, and it's been incredibly helpful. Thank you so much!" 💕

Come with your friends and dance however you like!  
And don't forget to dance with everyone else at the party too—it's just **one song per partner**, so it's easy to meet and dance with everyone. 😉👍

Ladies, you'll probably enjoy dancing even more if you wear comfortable practice shoes or heels 7 cm (about 3 inches) or lower. 😆🎶

We'll have delicious ♥️ Non-alcoholic cocktails ready for you! 🍹

By the way... last month our cocktail dispenser disappeared 😅 and someone even stole some soft drinks, so until our fresh Korean melons arrived, the drinks were a bit underwhelming. Sorry about that! 😂🙏

Just a reminder: **Vivimil does not sell or provide alcohol.**  
Feel free to bring your own drinks (**corkage fee**).  
If you'd like wine, you can purchase it yourself from **Pista's self-service wine refrigerator**.

Let's dance the night away again on July 19th!🥰
